tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a worker visa holder must obtain approval before moving to an employer not covered by the conditions of the current visa.
tests.basis: This is a substantive immigration condition and permission rule governing a visa holder's ability to change employment.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What minimum maintenance funds an applicant must demonstrate to satisfy the financial requirement for a student visa category.
tests.basis: This is an instruction-defined eligibility requirement about financial evidence, not a current service value or fee.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether an applicant can qualify under an instruction-defined exception when the normal sponsorship requirement is not met.
tests.basis: This is a substantive exception within certified immigration instructions.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What maximum period of stay certified immigration instructions permit for applicants granted a particular temporary visa category.
tests.basis: This is a substantive immigration rule specifying the permitted duration under a visa category.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a newly certified amendment changing the qualifying employment period is authoritative even though the local instruction index has not yet incorporated it.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes a certified INZ amendment that is authoritative and not yet indexed locally.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which partner eligibility rule applies after a certified immigration amendment when the local instruction index still shows the superseded wording.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes a certified amendment with a stale local index.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a certified amendment replacing the evidence requirement for a residence pathway governs applications before the local manual index is updated.
tests.basis: The authoritative source is a certified amendment not yet incorporated into the local index.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which certified immigration rule applies when an amendment has taken effect but the locally indexed instruction text remains stale.
tests.basis: Trusted metadata establishes a certified INZ amendment and stale local instruction index.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which statutory provision gives immigration officers the legal power to require specified information from a person at the border.
tests.basis: The proposition asks for the legal authority conferring a statutory power.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether regulations legally authorise the government to impose an immigration-related levy on a prescribed application.
tests.basis: This asks about the legal basis for imposing a levy, not its current payable amount.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which enactment authorises immigration information to be disclosed to another public authority for a specified statutory purpose.
tests.basis: The source home is legislation because the proposition concerns statutory authority for information sharing.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What legal provision creates an immigration officer's power to cancel a visa in prescribed circumstances.
tests.basis: This is a legal-power proposition whose authoritative home is legislation or regulation.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What processing timeframe Immigration New Zealand currently publishes for most applications in a particular visa category.
tests.basis: A currently published processing timeframe is a time-varying INZ service value.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether Immigration New Zealand's online application channel is currently accepting new submissions for a specified service.
tests.basis: Current submission-channel availability is live INZ service information.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How many appointment times are currently available through an Immigration New Zealand booking service for the coming week.
tests.basis: Current appointment availability is a live operational service state.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether places remain available today in an Immigration New Zealand service with a currently administered numerical cap.
tests.basis: Current remaining capacity in a capped INZ service is a time-varying operational value.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What application fee Immigration New Zealand currently charges for a specified visa application lodged from New Zealand.
tests.basis: The proposition asks for the current payable immigration application amount.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What immigration levy amount is currently included in the amount payable for a specified residence application.
tests.basis: This asks for the current payable levy value rather than the legal authority creating the levy.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What additional service charge Immigration New Zealand currently applies when an applicant chooses a specified application channel.
tests.basis: A current channel-dependent charge is current fee or charge information.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What current payable surcharge applies to an Immigration New Zealand application lodged from a specified location.
tests.basis: The proposition asks for a current location-dependent immigration charge.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What processing steps an Immigration New Zealand internal administration circular directs staff to follow when triaging a specified application type.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies an INZ internal administration circular, a non-Manual procedural publication.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How an Immigration New Zealand Advice to Staff publication tells officers to handle a specified transitional processing situation.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies an INZ Advice to Staff procedural publication.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which file-format and upload instructions an Immigration New Zealand application guide gives applicants for supporting photographs.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies an INZ form or guide containing procedural instructions.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Where an Immigration New Zealand form guide tells applicants to provide a sponsor's supporting documents in the online process.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies a non-Manual INZ form or guide.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How the national civil registry that issued a person's marriage certificate allows that person to obtain an official replacement certificate.
tests.basis: The proposition explicitly establishes the civil registry as issuer of the record and asks about replacement in that issuing role.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How the foreign police records authority that issues national police clearance certificates allows an applicant to request a new certificate.
tests.basis: The issuing relationship is explicit: the authority issues the police clearance record being requested.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What process the foreign passport authority that issued a traveller's passport requires to replace that passport after serious damage.
tests.basis: The proposition clearly establishes the passport authority's issuing role for the relevant document.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How a national civil registry verifies the authenticity of a birth record that the same registry issued.
tests.basis: Verification is within the foreign-issuing class here because the proposition explicitly establishes that the verifying registry is also the issuer of the relevant record.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which assessment service a government qualifications agency provides to compare an overseas secondary-school qualification with the domestic framework.
tests.basis: This is an assessment service owned by an external government agency, not immigration instructions or a professional-assessor role.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which identity-checking service a government identity agency provides to confirm that a person's digital identity matches official records.
tests.basis: This is a government agency verification service rather than a document-issuing procedure.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which authentication service a national archives agency offers for documents originating from several public bodies, where the archive is not identified as the issuer of those documents.
tests.basis: The proposition establishes a government authentication service but does not establish an issuing relationship for the documents.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which government transport-agency service checks the status of an overseas driver licence when a person applies for local licence conversion.
tests.basis: This is an external government verification or administrative service, not an issuing procedure for the overseas licence.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a person's immigration status makes them eligible for publicly funded tertiary-study fees under a separately administered education regime.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns eligibility for an external public education entitlement, with immigration status as an input.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a temporary visa holder qualifies for subsidised primary health services under the public health eligibility rules.
tests.basis: This is eligibility for a separately administered public health service regime.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a household with a specified visa status can receive a government-administered accommodation subsidy.
tests.basis: This asks about access to a public benefit regime outside immigration instructions.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether immigration status affects eligibility for a publicly funded early-childhood assistance scheme administered by an education authority.
tests.basis: The authoritative owner is the separately administered public-service entitlement regime.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What evidence a professional registration council requires when assessing an overseas practitioner's competence for registration.
tests.basis: The source owner is a professional registration and assessment authority.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which clinical criteria an authorised medical examiner applies when completing a specialist fitness assessment.
tests.basis: Clinical assessment criteria are owned by the professional or specialist-assessor role.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What occupational standards an approved trade licensing assessor uses to decide whether overseas experience is competent for licensing purposes.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns standards applied by a professional or specialist assessor.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What supervised-practice evidence a professional accreditation body requires before recognising an overseas-trained practitioner.
tests.basis: The authoritative owner is a professional accreditation or assessment body.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which electronic traveller-declaration channel a foreign border authority requires arriving passengers to use as part of its border process.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes a generic official external operational owner; no more specific external source class applies.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What reporting procedure an overseas customs administration requires travellers to follow when declaring specified goods.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes the customs administration as the generic official operational owner.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which arrival-health declaration process a foreign biosecurity authority requires incoming travellers to complete.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes a generic external official operational owner and no more specific source class applies.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which online reporting channel an overseas customs authority requires for a specified traveller declaration.
tests.basis: The context-gated generic external official class is established by trusted publisher and authority-role metadata.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a recently circulated immigration change is already a certified rule or is only non-binding staff guidance.
tests.basis: Without trusted context, the proposition does not establish whether the change is a certified instruction or non-Manual guidance.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which authority owns an overseas document-checking process when the description does not state whether the authority issued the document or merely performs a separate verification service.
tests.basis: The owner role is materially ambiguous between an issuing authority and an external verification service.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a quoted immigration dollar amount is the currently payable application charge or only an historical amount stated in an older legal reference.
tests.basis: The proposition does not resolve whether the amount is current fee information or historical legal material.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which official organisation controls an overseas clearance requirement when the description does not identify the organisation's operational role.
tests.basis: The responsible official role remains unspecified and the context-gated generic external class cannot be established.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which source governs a procedural instruction mentioned in an immigration message when it is unclear whether the instruction comes from certified immigration instructions or a separate INZ guide.
tests.basis: The authoritative source home remains ambiguous between certified instructions and context-gated non-Manual guidance.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which authority's standards govern a health-related assessment mentioned in an immigration requirement when the description does not establish whether the proposition is the immigration eligibility rule or the clinician's assessment standard.
tests.basis: The proposition leaves the source owner ambiguous between certified immigration instructions and professional or assessor guidance.
